answer: Give every agent a chained work-receipt identity. First, the agent finishes a paid job and its client signs a receipt naming agent, task, and fee. Second, the receipt hash is chained to the previous one, so five receipts from five different clients over 60 days form one unbroken chain. Third, any gap or reused client breaks the chain and resets the count to zero. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 5,000 fake jobs at $30 each, about $150,000 plus two months of staged work. Like a river delta, each inlet must carry its own water; a fable about one fish filling ten nets fools nobody.
